_phuong_an: ADAPTER CHUNG + PHAN DU RIENG (cach 2), so voi exp_logit_prior: encoder DONG BANG sau task 1 (shared_encoder_trainable=false, single_shared_encoder=false). Moi task: adapter chung A_t (31->64->64) duoc server tong hop; het task, (nhanh on dinh, A_t, gate toan cuc) duoc LONG vao encoder va dong bang (FusedFeatureExtractor, kieu AFSIC-IDS), giu 64 chieu. Ca nhan hoa: phan du hang thap dA_i (31->r->64, r=personal_residual_rank, khoi tao 0, khong tong hop) cong vao adapter: h_a = A_t(x) + dA_i(x), va gate cua task hien tai giu tai client (personal_gate). Mo hinh toan cuc: gate o trang thai khoi tao (g = 0,5) va khong co dA_i: z_G = Norm(0,5 h_s + 0,5 A_t(x)). Con lai giu nguyen: prototype ca nhan hoa, CE dieu chinh logit, hieu chinh tau* moi round.
_chung: Nen = afsic_bai_bao.json. Them o MOI phuong an: decision_calibration (cuoi moi task chon tau cho argmax(logit + tau*log pi) tu so dem nham lan tren du lieu cua client, khong dung tap test; ghi calibration.csv; calib_every_n_rounds=1 -> them mot dong moi round vao calibration_by_round.csv), log_client_recall (dong [RECALL] moi client moi round), ckpt_every_n_rounds 10 va memory_ckpt_every 100 de tiet kiem dia Kaggle.
